Atlas inventory

Anatomy coverage and gaps

Source-bound inventory of representations and documented gaps. These seven targets are a starting point, not an exhaustive curriculum. This inventory does not establish clinical approval or patient-space registration.

Inventoried scopes · all regions

{view.counts.specimenViews.toLocaleString('en-GB')}Independent specimen views
{view.counts.shoulder.toLocaleString('en-GB')}Dedicated shoulder selections

These are distinct, overlapping units across separate scopes. They cannot be added into a unique anatomy total or a completion percentage.

Reference backlog · separate file inventory

{view.reference.files.toLocaleString('en-GB')} reference files; {view.reference.differences.toLocaleString('en-GB')} current-root differences. The difference categories are {view.reference.nested.toLocaleString('en-GB')} reachable nested, {view.reference.corrected.toLocaleString('en-GB')} reviewed corrections or overlaps, {view.reference.held.toLocaleString('en-GB')} held for source condition or identity, and {view.reference.unsupported.toLocaleString('en-GB')} unsupported by current evidence.

These are file and difference counts, not missing structure counts. Original OBJ bytes were not revalidated by this inventory.

Snapshot provenance

Atlas source revision: {view.sourceRevision}. Inventory snapshot SHA-256: {view.inventoryRevision}. This read-only view contains no clinical decisions.

The exact snapshot and 141 imported source dependencies are checked here. The 25 source-only metadata inputs are verified by the separate source-inventory checker; original mesh bytes are not revalidated by this page.
